item.title: Preble County grand jury indicts Daniels, others
item.description: EATON — A Preble County grand jury returned multiple indictments during its Monday, Feb. 9 session. Among them was Gabriel Alex Daniels, 22, who was indicted on several felony charges, including attempted murder, in connection with a stabbing incident which occurred Jan. 9. item.title: Eaton Rotary selects 4-Way Test speech winners
item.description: EATON — The Rotary Four-Way Test Speech Contest is an annual competition for high school students designed to promote ethical decision-making and strengthen public speaking skills. Participants deliver original speeches applying Rotary’s Four-Way Test, a 24-word moral code, to a contemporary issue or personal experience. The post Eaton Rotary selects 4-Way Test speech winners appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Winter Guard performs at first competition of year
item.description: On Saturday January 31, the Eaton Winterguard which is made up of 8th through 12th graders competed at their first competition of the season. The team consists of 23 students and performs in the Mid Eastern Performance Association. This year, their show is titled “From seeds to Strength”. The team is led by Captain Sydney Atkinson, a junior at Miami Valley CTC.
